paragraphs: Rav Shmuel bar Chanina, or Chaninah.
Hyman writes that he said [teachings] in the name of Rabbi Elazar, as in Yoma ch. 5, halakha 4; and in the name of Rabbi Hoshaya, as in Berakhot ch. 2, halakha 5.
And in Moed Katan ch. 1, halakha 8, Rabbi Yassa gave a ruling to Shmuel bar Chanina.
Hyman also cites Midrash Tehillim, ch. 22, section 19, as mentioning him.

notes.text: The consulted Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 1:8 names Shmuel bar Chanina as the recipient of Rabbi Yassa’s ruling. The other locators are given as Hyman cites them.
